before: Application math payloads had no registered source projection. Native paragraph materializers refused new display math and could not retain exact equation sources through tool syntax.
after: Standard math syntax is emitted only when its source and kind roundtrip exactly. Registered inert equation syntax preserves other sources and GFM-sensitive inline pipes. Target parsing normalizes this syntax to the same math AST. New display equations carry validated payload bindings and readable native fallback paragraphs in one transaction.
reason: The adapter reuses the existing version-one equation payloads, native content controls, OPC records, sibling plans, and canonical operations. No core, Pro, shared schema, transport, or dependency changes occur. The new syntax is a private data-only Markdown representation; unknown extension metadata refuses instead of disappearing.
